_comment: THE INCLUDE LIST for the golf page: what it loads, in order, and nothing else.
GolfProvider after RenderProvider (the match drives RenderProvider's nodes by their verbs);
LayoutProvider so the eye fills the window whatever its size, its labels on their corners;
NetworkProvider for the match between runtimes (the room, the link, a surface of the host's match, the hall);
ShellProvider last so the navigator comes up in the embedded terminal.
_scripts: Staged into the browser's filesystem under these names before main() runs, each also
answering over HTTP (golf_mounts.etcs). A script's name is its OS path. The session's
(host, join, leave, close and their streams) are NetworkProvider's, every game's alike;
the hall's two are chess's: the hall is the site's name server for every game.
